# Homestead

> Homestead is a fictional business. This website is a design concept by Nuit Works (https://nuit.works), a web design studio. No products are sold, nothing is shipped, and no data or payments are collected.

Homestead is presented as a quiet-luxury living room furniture brand based in Malé, Maldives, with a showroom in Malé and Hulhumalé. The concept shows natural materials, slow craftsmanship and complimentary white-glove delivery across Greater Malé. Prices are shown in Maldivian rufiyaa (MVR).

## Pages

- [Home](https://homestead.nuit.works/): hero, featured pieces, craftsmanship teaser, newsletter sign-up
- [Shop](https://homestead.nuit.works/shop): all six pieces
- [Story](https://homestead.nuit.works/story): the brand's origin, materials and craftsmanship
- [Contact](https://homestead.nuit.works/contact): showroom details and a demo contact form

## Products (fictional)

- Hollis Sofa: MVR 52,900
- Ester Coffee Table: MVR 18,200
- Anders Floor Lamp: MVR 7,950
- Nook Bean Bag: MVR 5,900
- Fell Stool: MVR 3,650
- Vessel Planter: MVR 2,250
